source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: C9 behavior
steps.body: C9 after 110 s comm timeout: heater off, motor off, fault state. Often dead or frozen UI mid-cycle.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 110 sec timeout — heater off, motor off, go to fault state.

steps.title: CN9 display harness seated
steps.body: Access main PCB. Is CN9 (display communication) fully seated with no pin damage?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access main PCB. Is CN9 (display communication) fully seated with no pin damage?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Reseat CN9 harness; verify display ribbon at UI board.

steps.title: CN9 harness continuity
steps.body: With power off, verify continuity on CN9 harness between main PCB and display PCB (no opens).
steps.sourceExcerpt: With power off, verify continuity on CN9 harness between main PCB and display PCB (no opens).

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace display assembly or main PCB per failed path.

steps.title: Reseat and retest
steps.body: Reseat CN9 and display connectors; restore power and verify UI responds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat CN9 and display connectors; restore power and verify UI responds.

steps.title: Replace display or PCB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace display PCB assembly or main control board; retest for C9.

steps.title: Communication verified
steps.oemOutcome: CN9 path OK — C9 should not return.
